name: CAP cadet officer service cap insignia
size_basis: Scaled from Fig A5-8: ~80 px wide x 97 px tall against the 7.4 in cap band (300 px), ~1.9 x 2.4 in; the regulation gives no dimension.
provenance: CAPR 39-1 3 Mar 2020 Fig A5-8 (p.138, CAP DEVICES row; A5-9 shows the same devices on the women's caps); source figure is ~190 px of faint grey embossing: outline and large shading traced, no feather or leaf detail; CAP disc / shield and triangle are parametric

mounts.uniform: Men's / women's service cap, cadet officers
mounts.rule: centred on the front of the cap in device_slot_center; no clouds or darts (6.2.1.1.1, 6.2.1.2.1)

documented: cadet officers wear the cadet service cap insignia; no clouds and darts for cadets (6.2.1.1.1, 6.2.1.2.1)
